item.name: Hero's Hunting Proof
item.setBonus: None
item.howToGet: Dropped from Equipment Challenges. Enter from the Silent Sands portal or the Equipment wing of the Main City Daily Challenge.
item.cardSummary: The Attack-slot piece of the Epic Hero set. It fills an early gear slot, has no 3/3 bonus, and cannot be enhanced or refined.

item.name: Hero's Broken Crown
item.setBonus: None
item.howToGet: Dropped from Equipment Challenges. Enter from the Silent Sands portal or the Equipment wing of the Main City Daily Challenge.
item.cardSummary: The Defense-slot piece of the Epic Hero set. Wear it as a starter placeholder until a Legendary crown is ready, because Epic gear cannot be upgraded.

item.name: Hero's Talisman
item.setBonus: None
item.howToGet: Dropped from Equipment Challenges. Enter from the Silent Sands portal or the Equipment wing of the Main City Daily Challenge.
item.cardSummary: The Speed/HP piece of the Epic Hero set. It has no set bonus and is meant to be replaced once a real 3-piece Legendary set is complete.

item.name: Tidecalling Coral
item.setBonus: On first switch-in, raise Attack by 2 stages
item.howToGet: Dropped from Equipment Challenges. Enter from the Silent Sands portal or the Equipment wing of the Main City Daily Challenge.
item.cardSummary: The Attack-slot piece of Deepsea Lost Dream. Finish all three pieces for a two-stage Attack boost the first time the wearer switches in.

item.name: Azure Sea Coral Crown
item.setBonus: On first switch-in, raise Attack by 2 stages
item.howToGet: Dropped from Equipment Challenges. Enter from the Silent Sands portal or the Equipment wing of the Main City Daily Challenge.
item.cardSummary: The Defense-slot crown for Deepsea Lost Dream. Legendary versions require level 120, and the same name also drops as Mythic at level 140.

item.name: Ocean's Tear
item.setBonus: On first switch-in, raise Attack by 2 stages
item.howToGet: Dropped from Equipment Challenges. Enter from the Silent Sands portal or the Equipment wing of the Main City Daily Challenge.
item.cardSummary: The Speed/HP piece that completes Deepsea Lost Dream. The 3/3 bonus only turns on when this sits with Tidecalling Coral and Azure Sea Coral Crown on one Evomon.

item.name: Seraphic Fang
item.setBonus: On first switch-in, raise Special Attack by 2 stages
item.howToGet: Dropped from Equipment Challenges. Enter from the Silent Sands portal or the Equipment wing of the Main City Daily Challenge.
item.cardSummary: The Attack-slot piece of Court of the High Sky. A finished set gives a two-stage Special Attack boost the first time the wearer switches in.

item.name: Haloed Feather Crown
item.setBonus: On first switch-in, raise Special Attack by 2 stages
item.howToGet: Dropped from Equipment Challenges. Enter from the Silent Sands portal or the Equipment wing of the Main City Daily Challenge.
item.cardSummary: The Defense-slot crown for Court of the High Sky. Pair it with Seraphic Fang and Fate-Star Emblem before judging the set.

item.name: Fate-Star Emblem
item.setBonus: On first switch-in, raise Special Attack by 2 stages
item.howToGet: Dropped from Equipment Challenges. Enter from the Silent Sands portal or the Equipment wing of the Main City Daily Challenge.
item.cardSummary: The Speed/HP emblem that finishes Court of the High Sky. Use the full set on a special attacker that enters after the lead rather than opening the fight.

item.name: Windfalcon Plume
item.setBonus: On first switch-in, raise Speed by 2 stages
item.howToGet: Dropped from Equipment Challenges. Enter from the Silent Sands portal or the Equipment wing of the Main City Daily Challenge.
item.cardSummary: The Attack-slot piece of Galeplume Windfalcon. Completing the set raises Speed by two stages on the wearer's first switch-in.

item.name: Azure Wing Spirit Crown
item.setBonus: On first switch-in, raise Speed by 2 stages
item.howToGet: Dropped from Equipment Challenges. Enter from the Silent Sands portal or the Equipment wing of the Main City Daily Challenge.
item.cardSummary: The Defense-slot crown for Galeplume Windfalcon. Farm it with the plume and gem when winning turn order matters more than raw damage.

item.name: Windfalcon Gem
item.setBonus: On first switch-in, raise Speed by 2 stages
item.howToGet: Dropped from Equipment Challenges. Enter from the Silent Sands portal or the Equipment wing of the Main City Daily Challenge.
item.cardSummary: The Speed/HP gem that completes Galeplume Windfalcon. The 3/3 Speed boost only fires when all three pieces are on the same Evomon.

item.name: Shadowcrystal Claw
item.setBonus: On the wearer's first Ultimate, restore 2 Ultimate Energy
item.howToGet: Dropped from Equipment Challenges. Enter from the Silent Sands portal or the Equipment wing of the Main City Daily Challenge.
item.cardSummary: The Attack-slot claw of Nether Wandering Spirit. A finished set refunds Ultimate Energy after the wearer's first Ultimate.

item.name: Dreadhorn Skullcrown
item.setBonus: On the wearer's first Ultimate, restore 2 Ultimate Energy
item.howToGet: Dropped from Equipment Challenges. Enter from the Silent Sands portal or the Equipment wing of the Main City Daily Challenge.
item.cardSummary: The Defense-slot crown for Nether Wandering Spirit. Use the full set on Evomon that need a second Ultimate in a long fight.

item.name: Voidmoon Ring
item.setBonus: On the wearer's first Ultimate, restore 2 Ultimate Energy
item.howToGet: Dropped from Equipment Challenges. Enter from the Silent Sands portal or the Equipment wing of the Main City Daily Challenge.
item.cardSummary: The Speed/HP ring that finishes Nether Wandering Spirit. Equip it with the claw and skullcrown; mixed pieces do not grant the energy refund.

item.name: Blossomsea Spirit Stag Horn
item.setBonus: Restore 10% HP on a turn the wearer is in battle and does not attack
item.howToGet: Dropped from Equipment Challenges. Enter from the Silent Sands portal or the Equipment wing of the Main City Daily Challenge.
item.cardSummary: The Attack-slot horn of Blossomsea Spirit Stag. Completing the set restores 10% HP on turns the wearer stays in without attacking.

item.name: Prismatic Spirit Crown
item.setBonus: Restore 10% HP on a turn the wearer is in battle and does not attack
item.howToGet: Dropped from Equipment Challenges. Enter from the Silent Sands portal or the Equipment wing of the Main City Daily Challenge.
item.cardSummary: The Defense-slot crown for Blossomsea Spirit Stag. It belongs on stall or support Evomon that spend turns not attacking.

item.name: Gleaming Spiritlight Heart
item.setBonus: Restore 10% HP on a turn the wearer is in battle and does not attack
item.howToGet: Dropped from Equipment Challenges. Enter from the Silent Sands portal or the Equipment wing of the Main City Daily Challenge.
item.cardSummary: The Speed/HP piece that completes Blossomsea Spirit Stag. The heal only runs when all three pieces are equipped together.

item.name: Molten Gold Horn
item.setBonus: When HP falls below 50%, raise Defense and Special Defense by 3 stages
item.howToGet: Dropped from Equipment Challenges. Enter from the Silent Sands portal or the Equipment wing of the Main City Daily Challenge.
item.cardSummary: The Attack-slot horn of Ancient Lava Beast. A finished set spikes Defense and Special Defense by three stages after the wearer drops below half HP.

item.name: Blazing Flame Crown
item.setBonus: When HP falls below 50%, raise Defense and Special Defense by 3 stages
item.howToGet: Dropped from Equipment Challenges. Enter from the Silent Sands portal or the Equipment wing of the Main City Daily Challenge.
item.cardSummary: The Defense-slot crown for Ancient Lava Beast. Put it on bulky Evomon that can live a hit and then hold after crossing half HP.

item.name: Heart of Lava
item.setBonus: When HP falls below 50%, raise Defense and Special Defense by 3 stages
item.howToGet: Dropped from Equipment Challenges. Enter from the Silent Sands portal or the Equipment wing of the Main City Daily Challenge.
item.cardSummary: The Speed/HP gem that completes Ancient Lava Beast. Mix it with other sets and the low-HP defense spike never activates.
